chalmers.publisher: Chalmers University / author Magnus Wennberg, Saab EDS thesis
chalmers.kind: Primary comparison-method validation with deliberately unscaled radar plots; not numerical equipment accuracy calibration
chalmers.variant: PS-05/A STT; exact radar/software modification unspecified
chalmers.useful_claim: Three actual STT range-comparison flights, PDFpp45-54.
chalmers.non_admission: Section3.5 explicitly assumes radar/GPS sufficiently accurate and validates the comparison method. Target schematics are not to scale and all model dimensions were removed for confidentiality. Histogram distance axes have no numerical scale. No numerical radarerror may be recovered by digitization or inferred aircraft length; GPS accuracy is not radar accuracy.
chalmers.access: Independent webtext inspection ofSection3.5 and visual inspection of owner-rendered chalmers-page51.png/page53.png; bothhistogram distanceaxes lacknumerical ticks.
chalmers.section: 3.5 Test of Comparison Method, especially the final two paragraphs before3.5.1

saab_mk4.non_admission: SAR resolution and detection/acquisition range are not air-target measurement accuracy; Mk4 identity cannot be assumed for genericPS-05/A card.

admission_requirements: Exact card hardware/software variant or justified correspondence
Actual radar observations and measurementchannel/error definition
Range/aspect/RCS/SNR/mode/update/ECM/environment conditions sufficient to reproduce the measurement
Reference-position/time alignment and uncertainty, separately from radar uncertainty
Independent held-out residuals and documented calibration/uncertainty; specifications/methodagreement alone insufficient
excluded_evidence_classes: GPS/INSaccuracy is reference-instrument accuracy, not radarsensor accuracy
SAR/range resolution is not measurementerror RMS or confidence bound
Detectionrange, numberoftracks, testhours and meetsspecclaims do not identify error distributions
Game models, forums and sources repeating unspecified secondary estimates are not primary equipmentcalibration
Different radarvariants cannot be substituted because their names or platforms are related
